lines.zh: 我从沙里走出来，身上掉土。
lines.en: I walk out of the sand, shedding soil.
My joints click one by one.
One block a step, never resting.
Clods of earth cling to my ribs.
Every step leaves a pit.

lines.zh: 我一条腿拖在后面，照样走
lines.en: One leg drags behind and I keep walking.
The ground dries where I step.

lines.zh: 土自己把我顶出了地面
lines.en: The earth pushes me up out of itself.
My jaw never quite closes.
I walk along the field ridge.
My bones are black.
I walk as if counting paces.
My shadow is wider than a man's.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草不再长。
lines.en: Grass no longer grows where I pass.
I stand, and soil falls from me.
I cannot lift one arm.
My eyes are two empty sockets.
I turn my head slowly aside.
There are worms in the soil. I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我在等身体重新合起来。
lines.en: I wait for my body to heal together.
My knuckles grind together.

lines.zh: 我把散开的肋骨按回去。
lines.en: I press a loose rib back in.
I smell of damp earth.

lines.zh: 我胸口里没有东西在跳
lines.en: Nothing in my chest is beating.

lines.zh: 我站得非常直，很久没动。
lines.en: I stand very straight, long unmoving.
I listen to sounds below ground.

lines.zh: 我把手掌摊开，里面全是土。
lines.en: I open my palm; it is full of soil.
Wind passes through my chest.
You are standing in my field.

lines.zh: 我的脸看不清，你也不用看清。
lines.en: My face is unclear; you needn't see it.
When I move, soil falls.
That hoe in your hand is decent.
I know the smell of iron on you.
I have seen that backward step before.
I open my mouth and only soil falls out.

lines.zh: 我的下巴动了动，没声音。
lines.en: My jaw moves, with no sound.
What do you plant here?
Don't point that torch at me.

lines.zh: 我把一只手从垄沟里拔起
lines.en: I pull one hand up out of the furrow.
Why are you looking at me?
A chunk of soil falls off me.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，脚尖重新生根
lines.en: I tip over, then my feet take root again.
A crack has opened in my bone.
A clod fell off; I press it back.
I begin to piece myself together.
You shattered my shoulder.
I look down and press the soil back in.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚过一声土响。
lines.en: An earthy sound rolls in my throat.
I step back and sink a little.
My bones scattered; I still stand.
You give me iron?
I cannot hold that.
Set it down; I'll get it.
I eat soil, not that.

lines.zh: 你手指再近一寸，我就咬
lines.en: One inch closer and I bite.
I reach out slowly.
I've been chewing soil for half a month.
This smells raw.
Keep it; soil will do.
I nod, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞土墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a wall of earth.
Soil spills off my shoulder.
I step back and my foot sinks.

lines.zh: 你踩到什么很硬的东西了。
lines.en: You stepped on something very hard.
I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 别推我，我散架了要重拼。
lines.en: Don't push; if I come apart, I must rebuild.
You knocked off a finger bone.
I bend to pick it up and straighten.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，扬起一片土。
lines.en: We collide and raise a cloud of dust.
I let you go first.
I am already dead.
That no longer concerns me.
I am only earth and bone.
Don't come near; I have worms.

lines.zh: 我摇头，土从脖子里掉出来。
lines.en: I shake my head and soil falls from my neck.

lines.zh: 我等着再站起来，别的都不想。
lines.en: I only think of standing up again.

lines.zh: 你说话我还是听得懂的。
lines.en: I still understand when you speak.

lines.zh: 我在这片田里躺过很多年
lines.en: I have lain in this field for many years.
I have nothing to give.
I turn and walk away.
I cannot bend at the waist.
I nudge it with my foot.

lines.zh: 我拿脚趾把它夹住，慢慢抬
lines.en: I pinch it between my toes and lift it slowly.
This was buried in the soil.
I tuck it between my ribs.
The smell of iron, so familiar.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，看了看，又埋了。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and bury it again.
Fallen things sink eventually.
I cannot carry much.
I will pocket this and bury it later.
You trampled my field.

lines.zh: 我一节一节把身体拧过来。
lines.en: I twist my body around joint by joint.

lines.zh: 我出手很快，别以为我慢。
lines.en: I strike fast; don't mistake my walk.
You trampled my field. You'll pay.
The soil under me loosens.

lines.zh: 土松开，我又把身子立起
lines.en: The soil lets go and I lift myself upright again.
You cannot put me down many times.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就少等一步
lines.en: Each step you take is one less I wait.

lines.zh: 这块田写的是我的名字
lines.en: This field carries my name on it.
I lift the hoe.
My field is only so big.

lines.zh: 你埋了我，我还会从沙里出来。
lines.en: Bury me and I climb back out of the sand.

lines.zh: 你把土踩实了，我起得慢。
lines.en: You packed the soil down; I rise slowly.
I raise a hand and soil leaks from my cuff.
I follow, leaving deep prints.

lines.zh: 你打我的地方已经长好了。
lines.en: Where you struck me has already closed.
I lived again. Did you see?
The soil will piece me back together.
The more you hit, the harder I get.
I hold your hem.
You have backed to the field edge.
I am getting faster.
I need no air and do not tire.
Do you hear my joints?
I step in the soil you pressed down.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我的手就到了。
lines.en: One step more and my hand arrives.
One of my steps, two of your retreats.

lines.zh: 你砍过的地方已经长好了。
lines.en: Where you cut me has already closed.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸下去，土都震。
lines.en: My fist lands and the earth shakes.

lines.zh: 我的手扣住你的小腿往下拽
lines.en: My hand clamps your shin and pulls down.
This one is fast; you won't see it.
My finger bone jabs your ribs.

lines.zh: 我一掌下去，你陷进湿土
lines.en: One blow of my palm sinks you into the wet earth.

lines.zh: 我撞你，像一堵墙倒下来。
lines.en: I hit you like a falling wall.
My hand is hard and cold.
Block it and your hand goes numb.
With each blow, a layer of soil falls off me.
Try hitting me once more.
I shove you down.

lines.zh: 我出拳慢，落下来像塌方
lines.en: My swing is slow; it lands like a cave-in.
My fist lands and soil sprays up.

lines.zh: 我的手拍在你背上，很闷。
lines.en: My palm hits your back with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 泥沙翻开，我先露出的是手。
lines.en: The silt parts; my hand shows first.

lines.zh: 沙子从我空着的眼窝漏下。
lines.en: Sand trickles out of my hollow socket.
I rise very slowly.
The ground is loose here.
I woke again.

lines.zh: 我的手先出来，然后是头。
lines.en: My hand comes out first, then my head.

lines.zh: 泥沙从我骨缝里簌簌落
lines.en: Mud sifts down out of the gaps between my bones.
Someone is in this field.
My bones have knit.
I stand, waiting for my body to obey.
Half of me is still in the soil.

lines.zh: 我把脖子一节节转向你
lines.en: I turn my neck toward you joint by joint.
Wind passes between my ribs.
First I look for a stick.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的骨头，我不容易再起来。
lines.en: Fire eats my bones; I will not rise easily.
I fell and came apart into pieces.

lines.zh: 水把土冲散，我抓不住形状。
lines.en: Water washes the soil away; I lose my shape.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，骨头全乱了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my bones scatter.
An arrow lodges between my ribs.
Spell-light makes my bones brittle.

lines.zh: 没有土可以吃，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No soil to eat; I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷击把我的土烧成硬块。
lines.en: Lightning bakes my soil into hard lumps.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的骨头一块块抽走。
lines.en: The void pulls my bones away one by one.
